_comment: Job-progress deck (Dial 4). One card is drawn against each Active job each turn (after work burns). Target spread: neutral/minor ~40%, positive ~25%, negative ~25%, decisive ~10% — keep decisive low so jobs feel dramatic, not arbitrary. `copies` is expanded by the loader. Effects: work (± work_done), pay (± job value), cost (immediate cash hit), deadline (± turns), decisive ('success' completes now / 'failure' fails the job). Empty effect = nothing happens. The `flavor` field is pure immersion and has no mechanical effect.

cards.name: Routine day
cards.flavor: Just another day on the job.

cards.name: Minor setback
cards.flavor: A part shows up wrong; you improvise.

cards.name: Found a small efficiency
cards.flavor: You find a shortcut the Pettigrews never figured out.

cards.name: Ahead of schedule
cards.flavor: The crew's in a groove and pulls ahead of the clock.

cards.name: Happy client tips extra
cards.flavor: The client's so pleased they slip you a little extra.

cards.name: Rework needed
cards.flavor: The inspector makes you tear it out and do it by the book.

cards.name: Material cost overrun
cards.flavor: Materials run over the bid and you eat the difference.

cards.name: Change-order dispute
cards.flavor: The client changes their mind, then docks the bill for the trouble.

cards.name: Flawless execution
cards.flavor: Everything clicks — a flawless job folks will talk about at Dot's.

cards.name: Catastrophic failure
cards.flavor: It all goes sideways; the job's a write-off and your name's mud for a week.
